draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, describing what is right in front of you
notes: For 'grandfather', ตา specifically means the mother's father; the father's father is ปู่. It is also used as a polite pronoun or title for any older man of that age.
The classifier for eyes is ข้าง (one eye) or คู่ (a pair of eyes); in formal contexts ดวง is also used.
